problem:
What are the pivot columns of the matrix $A,$ given by

$$
A=[\begin{aligned}0 & 0 & 0 & 0 \\ 0 & 4 & 8 & -6 \\ 0 & -2 & -4 & 1 \\ 1 & 4 & 0 & 2\end{aligned}]?
$$

feedback.problem:
What are the pivot columns of the matrix $B,$ given by

$$
B=[\begin{aligned}0 & 0 & 2 & -1 \\ -1 & 0 & 3 & 3 \\ 0 & 0 & 0 & -4\end{aligned}]?
$$
feedback.worked_solution:
First, we need to convert $B$ to row echelon form:

$$
\begin{aligned}B & =[\begin{aligned}0 & 0 & 2 & -1 \\ -1 & 0 & 3 & 3 \\ 0 & 0 & 0 & -4\end{aligned}] & {R}_{1} & ↔{R}_{2} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}-1 & 0 & 3 & 3 \\ 0 & 0 & 2 & -1 \\ 0 & 0 & 0 & -4\end{aligned}]\end{aligned}
$$

Looking at the row echelon form, we see that $B$ has $3$ pivots. In particular, the pivot columns are the $1$st, $3$rd, and $4$th columns.
